name: farmkarts-fullstack
description: Full-stack agricultural marketplace application with Flutter frontend and Node.js backend

scripts.install:all: flutter pub get && npm run install:backend
scripts.clean: flutter clean && cd farmkart-backend && npm run clean || echo 'Backend clean script not available'
scripts.dev:backend: cd farmkart-backend && npm run dev || npm start
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && echo 'Setup complete! Run npm start to launch the application.'
